notes: Phase A rule ensemble (score.mjs). Each feature maps to a bounded logit contribution, positive toward a person, weighted by the feature's confidence; the sum plus the prior goes through a sigmoid. Kinds: ramp (linear from logit[0] at low to logit[1] at high, clamped), band (logit[0] inside [a, b], logit[1] outside), step (logit[0] below `above`, logit[1] at or above). A feature with logit [0, 0] is measured and reported but not scored until data tunes it. Tuned by hand from the synthetic sessions (detection/eval/synthetic.mjs) and to be re-tuned from detection/eval/REPORT.md. Environment tells (webdriver, console_wrapped) carry -5: alone they leave a session uncertain (held at 50 on the web), never likely automated against typing that looks like a person's.
